paragraphs.text: The Myojin of Seeing Winds is the Myojin kami of blue magic on Kamigawa .

The Myojin of Seeing Winds embodies the force of blue magic. When the Kami War began, Kamigawa's denizens prayed to the Myojin, hoping that the greatest kami had not turned against them, but due to Konda 's crime, the Myojin too were in such throes of chaos and anger that they couldn't begin to communicate the nature of that crime: like all other kami, the Myojin turned against the material world. It is not known how it is related to the Myojin of Cryptic Dreams which also represents an aspect of blue magic.
